status: Proposed (2026-10-09) by openspec/changes/repairs-on-deck, design 3b. Baked by tools/blender/build_repair_covers.py into assets/textures/repairs/cover_<finish>.png and interior_<kind>.png with assets/textures/repairs/covers.json; no engine code reads them yet.
_rules: One cover is baked per finish and stretched by its UVs onto every service cover from 1.1 to 1.4 wide to high; the screw holes stay at their fractions of the plate, which covers.json records and the 3D screws are placed from.
size_m is the plate baked (x across, y up); out_px the layer it becomes, at the same pixels per metre both ways; the render is supersample times out_px, area-averaged down.
Colours and wear are the finish's own in data/materials/panels.json, and the light is its render block: a cover is a wall part.

interiors: what the opening shows with the cover off (design 3b), baked at the cover's size and density. colours_srgb and wear are the interiors' own (a circuit board has no wall paint and no rust); each kind's roles map the build's material roles to those colours, and a role a kind does not name is refused on its faces.
